description: This file declares the TransportSecurityPersister class responsible for managing on-disk storage and serialization of transport security state information within the Chromium project. It includes methods for serializing/deserializing state, handling file IO, and integrating with TransportSecurityState.

classes.name: TransportSecurityPersister
classes.description: A class that manages serialization, deserialization, and disk storage of transport security state data, acting as a delegate for TransportSecurityState and implementing data serialization.

methods.name: TransportSecurityPersister
methods.description: Constructor initializing the persister with state, task runners, and data file path.

methods.name: StateIsDirty
methods.description: Callback invoked when the security state changes, marking data as needing to be persisted.

methods.name: WriteNow
methods.description: Immediately serializes and writes the current state to disk, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: SerializeData
methods.description: Serializes the current transport security state into a JSON string, returning an optional string.

methods.name: LoadEntries
methods.description: Loads and applies serialized state data into the transport security state.
